verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation or community reports of ORM or framework integration guides (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails) for PlanetScale. The cited docs cover branching, deploy requests, backups, the CLI and the MCP server, none of which is about ORM compatibility. ORM and framework support is a fair question for a database platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, the database works out of the box with my ORM and framework (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails) with documented guides
